action.prompt: Before running this forge/cast command, verify it does NOT target a mainnet RPC URL or chain id 1 / 56. If it does, refuse and explain that mainnet deploys are forbidden in this repo (see .kiro/steering/security.md). Local (anvil, chain 31337) and BSC testnet (chain 97) are allowed.

hooks.description: Gate any forge/cast command that targets a mainnet RPC. Only local/testnet deploys are allowed during the hackathon.
hooks.name: Block mainnet deploys

action.prompt: Before this commit, confirm no private keys, mnemonics, API keys, or real wallet addresses are staged. Run `git diff --cached` mentally and refuse the commit if anything sensitive appears.

hooks.description: Before a git commit is finalized, remind the agent to check for secrets.
hooks.name: No secrets in commits
